data.labels: Actual referee result, red win=1, black win=0, quiet draw=0.5. No engine score labels.
data.weighting: Equal total weight per initial layout, equal games within layout, equal observations within game.

training.selection: Lowest validation weighted BCE among epochs 1..120; test is evaluated once after freezing the selected model.

matches.rule: Third same public board and turn loses for mover; mate/stalemate priority.120 quiet plies draw;400-ply cap unresolved.
matches.stopRule: Finish the entire prespecified plan regardless of wins; pause safely only for quota/access/technical execution blockers. No tuning after results.

publication: Only after completed checks and privacy/provenance review, under the user's subsequent explicit publication approval. Default engine remains unchanged.

correctnessAmendment.reason: Include every NNUE input dependency in transposition/path keys: per-type inventories, including equal-value advisor/elephant alternatives.
correctnessAmendment.pilotUse: Retain all attempts and technical failures, but no strength conclusion from the deficient integration.
